title: The First Wake · The Geometry of Becoming

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The game takes place inside a Pocket, a system with its own closed rules.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then a record contains an event whose effects seem to precede its production.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Rill discovers a dependency that the accepted account of time cannot comfortably explain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its playful investigation suddenly attracts attention far beyond the game.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That opening gives the reader a concrete mystery before the larger argument takes shape.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Rill does not investigate alone; its closest bond is with Skein.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Skein maintains Bridges between systems that do not share the same rules.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Where Rill rushes toward an exception, Skein slows down to examine it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their exchanges contain teasing, irritation, caution, and affection, despite having no spoken sound.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That contrast gives the novel an emotional centre inside its unfamiliar reality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader follows a relationship as well as an investigation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their differences matter because each makes futures possible that the other would miss.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One of the first distinctions is between succession and rate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Succession tells us that one state comes after another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Rate compares how many transformations different processes can perform.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Duration asks another question, requiring some way to measure an interval.
